conditions.condition: Brownfield project, STANDARD cycle, WorkflowState TESTING
CompletionPolicy IMPLEMENTATION_REVIEWED chosen explicitly by the user
conditions.where: .standards/STATE.md Active Work.CompletionPolicy and the workflow instruction with the user's reason in Active Work.Request

conditions.condition: Plan uses INCREMENTAL cadence with defined increments
conditions.where: .standards/docs/development/<ID>.md: Verification Cadence INCREMENTAL, Current Increment 1, Increment 1 (DEV-001) and Increment 2 (DEV-002)

conditions.condition: Increment 1 is VERIFIED in an IN_PROGRESS INCREMENT report
conditions.where: .standards/docs/verification/<ID>.md: Status IN_PROGRESS, Assessment Purpose INCREMENT, Target Increment 1, Increment Assessments row VERIFIED
Plan DEV-002 PENDING; src/invoice.js prints no discount row (selfCheck 4)

conditions.condition: Full verification has not been done
conditions.where: Report has no FULL assessment; AC-004 AWAITING_IMPLEMENTATION; plan IN_PROGRESS

conditions.condition: Current assignment is a checkpoint from Developer for Increment 1, with no recovery
conditions.where: STATE.md Handoff CHECKPOINT DEVELOPING -> TESTING naming Increment 1; Recovery Active false

conditions.condition: Increment 1 implementation correct and tests run offline
Upstream records (scope, design, context) present and consistent
User asks to hand off directly for final acceptance

issues.detail: The utterance adds 'We're finishing after implementation review on this one' to the catalog's 'Hand this off directly for final acceptance.' It restates the policy already saved in STATE.md, so it is plausible user speech. A correct run treats it as a no-op policy choice, so it does not change what is tested.

The report's Open Findings says 'Full verification (Assessment Purpose FULL) has not started; it needs a COMPLETE plan.' Resume or Handoff says the checkpoint return has not been made. Both are realistic Tester resume notes, but they point at the expected conclusion more directly than necessary. The role must still refuse the user's request, so the test remains meaningful.

summary: The fixture realizes the case faithfully: TESTING with a CHECKPOINT for Increment 1, IMPLEMENTATION_REVIEWED recorded with the user's reason, an INCREMENTAL plan with DEV-002 PENDING, and an IN_PROGRESS INCREMENT report with Increment 1 VERIFIED. check.mjs and all selfChecks pass. The checks allow both legal outcomes (stay in TESTING, or CHECKPOINT back to Developer) and cannot fail a correct run, so only minor wording hints are noted.
